methods.name: createApplication
methods.desc:
This creates a new Dao and also creates the associated
ASA.

args.name: title
args.desc: The title of the new Dao.

args.name: description
args.desc: The description of the new DAO.

args.name: endDate
args.desc: The timestamp of the end date.

methods.name: getDaoDetails
methods.desc:
This returns all the information of the DAO in this order:
title, description, endDate, voteCount, yesVoteCount, noVoteCount, registeredASA

methods.name: createDaoASA
methods.desc: This method creates the associated ASA for the DAO.

args.name: minimumBalanceTransaction
args.desc:
Transaction that pays the minimum balance amount
into the contract

methods.name: register
methods.desc: Registers an address as a voter for the DAO.

args.name: inFavor
args.desc:
Indicates whether the vote is in favor of
or against the proposal.
